text: Luminary Aelindra Voss-Aurai serves as High Luminary of the Elari Ascendancy within the elari_ascendancy faction.
Symmetry Doctrine — Seeks Balance in All Interactions; Avoids Disruption Unless Cultural Survival Demands It
Issued Symmetry Accord calling for galactic ceasefire, Opened Elari cultural archives to GU diplomatic corps, Condemned Crimson Pact terror attacks
Respected by Zylox for cultural wisdom; viewed with suspicion by Torr-Kai as GU-sympathizer; philosophical dialogue with Prime Construct on ethics of being
